verdict.rationale: Modal markets Sandboxes as isolated dev environments for autonomous agents, with custom images, exec, and an interactive shell ([modal-docs-3], [modal-docs-2], [modal-docs-13], [modal-docs-15], [modal-probe-2]). It also publishes a first-party example of a coding agent whose code runs in a Sandbox ([modal-docs-22], [modal-docs-30]). That recipe is for a custom-built LLM agent, though, not for installing and running Claude Code or Codex, so doing that requires your own image and setup work. Missing for 10: a vendor recipe or guide specifically for running Claude Code or Codex in a Sandbox, documented handling of agent credentials and auth, and hands-on or community corroboration of running these agents.
